items.authoringDescription: Hongying's inheritance -- the lance her father carried the night he fell at Mengjin Ford.
items.authoringUseDescription: A divine relic: stands outside the mortal weapon lineages. Deadly against armored foes.

items.authoringDescription: The heirloom sword of the Pei household -- Yu Cong's birthright, carried from the prologue.
items.authoringUseDescription: A divine relic: stands outside the mortal weapon lineages. Reforged into Mingzhu in chapter 17.
